episodes.title: Ny gutt
episodes.summary: Returning to his family's hometown, awkward teenager Magne discovers his strange new powers. Still, the hamlet's natural beauty cloaks dark secrets.

episodes.title: 541 meter
episodes.summary: Magne and his classmates try to regroup after a tragic loss, while the police seem uninterested in getting to the truth. Gry stumbles on Vidar unmasked.

episodes.title: Jutulheim
episodes.summary: The break-in confirms what Magne suspects: He must take matters into his own hands. After tying up loose ends, the Jutuls put the teen to the test.

episodes.title: Ginnungagap
episodes.summary: A search for answers brings Magne back to a mysterious woman — and a meaningful mountain. Turid confronts Ran, and former BFFs Gry and Saxa get heated.

episodes.title: Atomnummer 48
episodes.summary: As Fjor holds Vidar back, Magne takes the blame, then tries a new tack. Threats abound, and the greatest is the explosive find that Isolde left behind.

episodes.title: Ja, vi elsker dette landet
episodes.summary: While attempting to expose the truth, Magne gets another shock. Hope seems lost, but have the Jutuls underestimated their foe — and the power of good?

episodes.title: Brothers in Arms
episodes.summary: A battle ends with a bang — and an ominous promise of violence. After visiting another realm, Magne hunts for allies while Vidar marshals his forces.

episodes.title: Hva skjedde med den snille, gamle damen?
episodes.summary: The truth hurts, and a fight for hearts and minds kicks off. Vidar gets under Magne's skin, Iman feels her power, and Laurits discovers his dark side.

episodes.title: Power to the People
episodes.summary: Edda rises: Magne confronts Ran, and Laurits proves a point. As protests gather momentum, a king walks again, and a master manipulator gets played.

episodes.title: Gud er Gud, om alle mann var døde
episodes.summary: A patriarch passes — and a strange new creature is born. Magne tries to change, Laurits lashes out and Fjor charts a new path. Saxa and Iman step up.

episodes.title: Kjenn deg selv
episodes.summary: In a seismic shift, Magne rejects strength, Fjor makes a power grab and a circle closes ranks. Laurits learns the truth, and Iman reaches out to Ran.

episodes.title: All You Need Is Love
episodes.summary: Desperate times fire up Magne and his crew as they go on a risky mission. The Jutuls face an unforeseen enemy while a formidable ancient force awakens.

episodes.title: War Is Over
episodes.summary: Bereft of his hammer, Magne continues to battle the Giants while complying with modern rules. But when he breaks a pact, the truce crumbles.

episodes.title: Til døden skiller oss ad
episodes.summary: The Jutuls decide to play along with Magne's antics to make him more open to Saxa's plan. Feeling rejected by everyone, Laurits finds support in Jens.

episodes.title: Losing My Religion
episodes.summary: Under Saxa's spell, Magne continues to fall further from himself — a perfect distraction for Fjor to enact his vicious plan and set a dangerous trap.

episodes.title: My Precious
episodes.summary: More vulnerable than ever, Magne requires backup to face his relentless foes. An impossible ultimatum threatens Laurits' loved ones.

episodes.title: Farvel til våpnene
episodes.summary: As Magne's arrogance sows discord among his allies, the gods stand at a crossroads between forging lasting peace or fighting the impending battle.

episodes.title: Ragnarok
episodes.summary: Despite Edda's embrace of a new dawn, the young God of Thunder cannot evade the predestined future that awaits.
